answer: One voyage means one spiral route in the voyage registry, sealed by an ember key binding route, time, and identity; reused seals are rejected. Same-route tracks must depart two hours apart; auditors recompute gaps publicly. Each filer locks 70 credits and pays a window fee: a window holds 100 voyages, so the kth filer pays 20 times its window number, 20 first, 200 for the thousandth. A track-sharing ring reusing one spiral track fails, since zero separation burns both bonds. One thousand fakes pay 110,000 in fees and lock 70,000, while one honest agent pays 20 and recovers its bond.
